hotspots.name: Village Well
hotspots.description: A stone well at the center of Wolfpine. Fresh rope cuts mark the rim, and villagers have left covered buckets nearby.

hotspots.name: Notice Board
hotspots.description: A damp board nailed to old posts. Most notices are water-blurred, but one fresh notice bears a guard seal: all mill tallies are to be checked against emergency grain tithes before the next bake.

hotspots.name: Market Stall
hotspots.description: A striped awning covers onions, dried fish, tallow candles, and a basket of black, gritty loaves. The stallkeeper has cut one open to show the ash-colored crumb and the husks hidden inside.

hotspots.name: Miller's Tally Window
hotspots.description: The miller's tally window is shuttered from within, but a wet scrap of copied manifest lies caught under the sill. One passenger line has been rubbed pale with ash instead of scratched with a knife, as if someone practiced erasing the name before the real ledger vanished.

hotspots.name: Blackfen Fish Crates
hotspots.description: Three fish crates stink beside the market runoff. Their lids carry the same three-cut route mark seen near the shrine ruts, but the pitch seal has been broken and pressed shut again with guard-house wax.

hotspots.name: Guardhouse Rope Hooks
hotspots.description: A rack of rope hooks stands beside the guardhouse lean-to. One hook is clean where rain should have rusted it, and a strand of red wagon cord still clings to the tooth. Someone cut loose a load in a hurry and returned the tool too carefully.
